title: AgentHostConfig
description: The rendered per-host bundle config (rendered/agent/<host>.yaml). Authored by host-agent (REQ-CFG-01); pulse-cli's emitAgent() renders values to it (REQ-CFG-02). Both delivery forms consume this one config (REQ-CFG-03). Matches AgentHostConfig in 00-core-definitions.md §4.

host.description: Host identity — matches the estate host `name`.

deliveryForm.description: Which delivery form this host installs (REQ-BUNDLE-02). Selects the compose fragment vs the systemd units from one shared config.

cadvisor.description: cAdvisor opt-in for this host (REQ-CONT-01). When true, scrapePorts.cadvisor MUST be present.

heartbeat.description: heartbeat exporter opt-in for this host (issue #30/#33; defaults true in the estate). When true, scrapePorts.heartbeat MUST be present and deploy-toolkit installs the heartbeat container/unit; when false it is a node-exporter-only host.

scrapePorts.description: Local scrape ports the central engine reaches (REQ-BUNDLE-03). Local metric endpoints only — no control/write surface (REQ-SEC-02).

cadvisor.description: cAdvisor port — present only when the host declares cadvisor: true (REQ-CONT-01). Conventional 8080 (tech-spec §3.7).

heartbeat.description: heartbeat exporter port — present IFF the host declares heartbeat: true (issue #30/#33). Absent for a node-exporter-only host. Conventional 9110 (tech-spec §3.7).

allOf.description: cAdvisor coherence (REQ-CONT-01): scrapePorts.cadvisor is present IFF cadvisor is true.
heartbeat coherence (issue #30/#33): scrapePorts.heartbeat is present IFF heartbeat is true.
